seed: Objects of type `marker` under action ACTION6 with touching neighbours [hit,wall] show mixed outcomes: gone x1, no_change x1. Find the condition in the before state that decides the outcome. Start from this kind of condition: a field of the object itself, such as its tags, pixels, visibility or layer. Verify it against every transition before you keep it.

synth.notes:
Mirror-blocks game, frame in/out: floor colour 5, walls 15/8 drawn (maze visible), blocks 10, armed players 1, markers 9, active marker 11.
Block mode: A1/A2 both blocks y-/+4; A3 left x-4/right x+4, A4 reverse; each block moves only if target 4x4 is all floor.
Click inactive marker arms (blocks->1, marker->11) or switches active; click player disarms; click active marker/block = no-op (resolves the marker A6 gone vs no_change hypothesis).
Armed: A1-4 move active marker 4px if its 4x4 cell (marker pos-1) target is floor; A5 no-op.
HUD timer w=3(a+1)//7 zeros, row 0 right-aligned and row 63 left-aligned; a continuity-gated, fallback 0 if no bar else (7w+2)//3. Unconfirmed: A5 in block mode, bar beyond 64.
